name: High Executor Darthalia
summary: At Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia directs the Forsaken war in Hillsbrad. Under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras, she targets Southshore and the Syndicate.

sections.title: Commander of Tarren Mill
sections.body: From Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia commands Forsaken forces. She works to contain the human forces in Southshore and hunt Syndicate brigands across the Hillsbrad Foothills. Every Forsaken offensive in southern Hillsbrad passes through her command.

sections.title: The War for Hillsbrad
sections.body: High Executor Darthalia follows orders from Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras, the Undercity's leaders. She directs the war across Hillsbrad through scouting and strikes against human leaders. Bounties target outlaws who threaten Forsaken control of northern Lordaeron.

faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia leads Forsaken forces in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She directs their efforts against Southshore and the Syndicate.
Darthalia commands Forsaken forces from Tarren Mill. From there, she coordinates troops and strikes across central Lordaeron.
Darthalia answers to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and Varimathras, the Undercity's leaders.

faq.q: What tasks does Darthalia give to adventurers?
faq.answer: Darthalia sends Horde champions against human settlements and dangerous outlaws. Among them are Syndicate members throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why is Darthalia fighting the humans of Southshore?
faq.answer: Darthalia fights to contain Southshore's Alliance forces and protect Tarren Mill. She seeks to stop them from pushing north toward the Undercity.

faq.q: What is Darthalia's rank in the Forsaken military?
faq.answer: As a High Executor, Darthalia holds high rank in the Forsaken military. She commands regional forces, outposts, and war strategy in Hillsbrad.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you see Darthalia's resolve to keep Lordaeron in undead hands.
As a Horde adventurer, you report to Darthalia to oppose the Alliance and hold Hillsbrad's contested frontier.
To Southshore's humans and their allies, Darthalia leads assaults that threaten their foothold in Lordaeron.
